summary: Website updates: apply UI/content corrections across hero, features, gallery, Our Story (Read More), and footer; mitigate deployment errors by deploying smaller incremental changes without extra credits.
architectural_notes: To avoid deployment failures, break large updates into smaller incremental deployments (draft builds/deployments) and only push final combined version to production.
known_issues: Deployments may fail when updates are too large/complex (many files/components changed at once).

existing_features.title: Fix the landing page brand/logo rendering so the GrowInLove tree logo never appears as a broken-image placeholder in the header or footer, and the brand block remains visually aligned across mobile/desktop.

Tighten vertical spacing on the landing page sections (hero, benefit cards, carousel section header, story, privacy, final CTA, footer) to reduce excessive empty space on mobile while preserving readability.
Adjust landing screenshot presentation (hero phone showcase and screenshot carousel) so screenshots fit consistently without cropping important UI, maintaining correct aspect ratios.
Update the “Our Story” section to show a shortened preview by default and provide a clear “Read more” / “Read less” interaction to expand/collapse the full founder story text.
Clean up the “Explore the features” section UI to match the intended accordion behavior and polish interaction cues (e.g., chevron rotation/state), ensuring it looks consistent on mobile.
Correct landing footer issues: ensure footer spacing is tidy on mobile, fix any duplicated/misaligned branding, and implement a working Contact action that provides an explicit email link (mailto).
Implement the above landing-page corrections as a small, landing-only change set to reduce deployment risk (avoid touching unrelated pages/components).
